_comment: Reference sources that seed the crawlers. Edit freely or override with env vars (YT_REFS/YT_CHANNELS, X_ACCOUNTS, IG_PROFILES, LINKEDIN_REFS). Content is ALWAYS scraped LIVE — this file only says WHERE to look, never hard-codes results. The intent here is tech/AI INDUSTRY NEWS and breakthroughs from famous creators & companies — NOT beginner tutorials (a tutorial filter in lang.py + crawlerService drops those titles).

youtube._comment: channels = @handles (precise; recent uploads pulled live) or plain channel names (matched via yt-dlp search). Famous tech/AI news + industry commentary creators. videos = optional reference video IDs/URLs whose whole channel is scraped; left empty so no tutorial channels leak in.

instagram._comment: profiles = public tech accounts to read (needs instaloader, rate-limited); posts = reference post/reel shortcodes. Anonymous IG scraping is heavily rate-limited, so expect best-effort.

x._comment: Famous AI/tech companies & builders. Read LIVE via twscrape (pip install twscrape, then run 'twscrape add_accounts' or 'twscrape add_cookie' to configure YOUR X account) - their latest posts become topics. Dormant (prints []) until an account is set, so Postly keeps working with zero X credentials. Extend/override with X_ACCOUNTS env.

bsky._comment: NEW topic source. Read LIVE via Bluesky's public AT Protocol API (public.api.bsky.app) - no key, no account needed. authors = handles (best-effort; unknown ones are silently skipped). queries = live search terms and are the reliable driver. Extend/override with BLUESKY_AUTHORS / BLUESKY_QUERIES env.

linkedin._comment: posts = any public URL mirrored into topics through the agent-reach web channel (Jina Reader): each page's headings become fresh topics. Seeded with big company / lab newsrooms so you get real AI/tech updates. Add your own links or extend via LINKEDIN_REFS.
